response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience, deep systems thinking, and exposure to AI-agent tooling, but lacks clear evidence of staff-level technical strategy in AI-native environments, has no demonstrated Python mastery, and shows no operational ownership or on-call experience — critical for this role.
strengths: Extensive distributed systems experience across high-throughput platforms
Proven contribution to AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling
Strong open-source leadership and cross-stack adaptability
concerns: No demonstrable Python expertise — a core must-have skill
Missing evidence of operational ownership or incident response on-call
No clear track record of technical strategy at staff level in AI-driven engineering
